member.summary: Converts legacy FilterOptions properties to gitignore-style filtering rules. This ensures backward compatibility with code using the old filtering API.
Converts legacy list-based FilterOptions to gitignore-style rules for compatibility. Generates patterns like "**/*.ext" or "!**/*name".

member.name: M:FileTree.Core.Filtering.LegacyFilterConverter.ConvertToGitIgnoreRules(FileTree.Core.Models.FilterOptions)
member.summary: Converts legacy filter options to gitignore-style rules.
member.param: The FilterOptions containing legacy filter properties.
member.returns: A list of gitignore-style rule strings.
member.remarks:
Conversion rules: - ExcludeExtensions: Converts to "**/*{ext}" patterns - ExcludeNames: Converts to "{name}" patterns - IncludeExtensions: Converts to "*" (exclude all) followed by "!**/*{ext}" (except these) - IncludeNames: Converts to "!{name}" (negation patterns)
Note: The order matters in gitignore. Include rules must come after exclude rules to properly negate them.
